panels.title: ① Is each client's data arriving?
Ingest rate by client (rows/s)
panels.description: sum by(tenant) rate(oeecloud_worker_batch_writes_total{result="ok"}[5m]). Rows/s the worker commits per client. A line dropping to 0 while others flow = that client stopped sending. tenant = SparkPlug group (cpack→CPACK, bispharmastaging→Bispharma, sbxcpack→sandbox).

panels.title: Ingest ERRORS by client (rows/s) — flat 0 = healthy
panels.description: sum by(tenant) rate(oeecloud_worker_batch_writes_total{result="error"}[5m]). A CounterVec with no error label yet reads EMPTY = healthy (no failed writes). A non-flat line = that client's writes are erroring — page the pipeline team.

panels.title: Live data freshness by client (last 15 min)
panels.description: silver.equipment_values arrivals in the last 15 min, per client, with age of the newest row. age (s) climbing = data drying up. A client absent from this table sent nothing in 15 min (idle or disconnected).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ent.nm_enterprise AS "client", count(*) AS "rows/15m", max(ev.ts_value) AS "last message", round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()-max(ev.ts_value)))::int AS "age (s)" FROM equipment_values ev JOIN enterprises ent ON ent.id_enterprise=ev.id_enterprise WHERE ev.ts_value > now()-interval '15 minutes' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 4 DESC

panels.title: Queue backlog by client (ready messages)
panels.description: rabbitmq_detailed_queue_messages for each per-tenant live queue (stream-engine-q-<tenant>, excluding -retry-30s/-failed). Each client has its OWN queue = isolation: one client backing up does not stall another. A rising line = the worker isn't keeping up for THAT client.

panels.title: Poison messages (DLQ) — all clients
panels.description: sum of rabbitmq_detailed_queue_messages on every stream-engine-q-<tenant>-failed queue. 0 = healthy (no message has exhausted retries). Any non-zero = messages a client sent that the worker could not process — investigate that client's config.

panels.title: Clients with a live consumer
panels.description: count of per-tenant live queues that have >= 1 attached consumer (rabbitmq_detailed_queue_consumers). Should equal the number of active clients. A drop = a client's queue lost its consumer (worker down / single-active-consumer failover not landed) → that client silently stops ingesting.

panels.title: Per-client consumer capacity (is the consumer keeping up?)
panels.description: rabbitmq_detailed_queue_consumer_capacity per client queue. 1.0 = the single active consumer is fully able to take messages (healthy). A value near 0 WHILE backlog > 0 = the consumer is stalled — the classic single-active-consumer failure to alert on.

panels.title: ③ OEE — business health per client
OEE by client (last 24h, producing shifts)
panels.description: gold.equipment_oee_shift averaged over shifts with running_time>0 in the last 24h, clamped to valid [0,1]. Blank OEE = a client with shifts but no production in-window (idle) — not an error. A × P × Q are the three OEE factors.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ent.nm_enterprise AS "client", count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.running_time>0) AS "producing shifts", ROUND((AVG(r.oee) FILTER (WHERE r.running_time>0 AND r.oee BETWEEN 0 AND 1)*100)::numeric,1) AS "OEE %", ROUND((AVG(r.oee_a) FILTER (WHERE r.running_time>0 AND r.oee_a BETWEEN 0 AND 1)*100)::numeric,1) AS "A %", ROUND((AVG(r.oee_p) FILTER (WHERE r.running_time>0 AND r.oee_p BETWEEN 0 AND 1)*100)::numeric,1) AS "P %", ROUND((AVG(r.oee_q) FILTER (WHERE r.running_time>0 AND r.oee_q BETWEEN 0 AND 1)*100)::numeric,1) AS "Q %" FROM equipment_oee_shift r JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment=r.id_equipment JOIN enterprises ent ON ent.id_enterprise=e.id_enterprise WHERE r.ts_value BETWEEN now()-interval '24 hours' AND now() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: OEE trend by client (hourly)
panels.description: Hourly mean OEE per client from gold.equipment_oee_shift, valid shifts only, r.ts_value <= now() (excludes future-dated shift-calendar rows). Follows the same guards as the library Factory-analysis board.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', r.ts_value) AS time, ent.nm_enterprise AS metric, ROUND((AVG(r.oee) FILTER (WHERE r.running_time>0 AND r.oee BETWEEN 0 AND 1)*100)::numeric,1) AS oee FROM equipment_oee_shift r JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment=r.id_equipment JOIN enterprises ent ON ent.id_enterprise=e.id_enterprise WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts_value) AND r.ts_value <= now() GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING AVG(r.oee) FILTER (WHERE r.running_time>0 AND r.oee BETWEEN 0 AND 1) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: OEE freshness — latest completed shift by client
panels.description: max(ts_value) <= now() per client from gold.equipment_oee_shift, i.e. how current the computed OEE is. age (h) climbing = the rollup has stopped advancing for that client (see the Pipeline board's rollup-freshness tile). Future-dated calendar rows are excluded by the <= now() guard.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ent.nm_enterprise AS "client", max(r.ts_value) AS "latest shift", round((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()-max(r.ts_value))/3600.0)::numeric,1) AS "age (h)" FROM equipment_oee_shift r JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment=r.id_equipment JOIN enterprises ent ON ent.id_enterprise=e.id_enterprise WHERE r.ts_value <= now() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC
